what: OA-13 (MED, Tier-1). The live-vs-replay parity check reads ok when its own controls could not run. Verified by the lane: scripts/ops/live_replay_parity.py:1197 counts a control as bad only on state=='fail', and findings() (~1309) only emits a failed control. So planted_defect=could_not_check (any quiet week) or historical_positive=partial still yields status=ok, exit 0 and no ping, a green while the check could not look. Proposed: map could_not_check/partial controls to a distinct status 'controls_unproven' (exit 2) and include them in findings(). Coordinate with lane LIVE-SILENCE-2, which owns the parity divergences.
